title: UK to Send Fighter Jets to Help Defend Saudi Arabia From Houthi Attacks
summary_full: R.A.F. Typhoon fighter jets will be deployed to protect infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, Britain said, after a spike in attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi militia.
